Back in July, they came to my home to install a Flow Tech descaling device. Just a few days later, I noticed the device had completely shut off, so I called the company and was told a technician would come the next day. I waited the entire day and no one showed up. I called again the following day, and they told me the same thing—but once again, no one c

I had an excellent experience with Reliant Plumbing. My technician Cullen arrived right on time, was very honest, and gave me all the information I needed. He took the time to answer every question I had, which made the process smooth and stress-free. I truly appreciate his professionalism and highly recommend him for anyone in need of plumbing services.

Horrible experience, negligence, incompetence, theft and lies. Wrong water heater installed, installed it incorrectly, blew my breakers and damaged them. Sales tech said they wouldn’t install a Home Depot water heater and did exactly that. Initial installers lied about how they messed up, but I was there so they couldn’t get away w it. If I hadn’t been I would have had to pay for the first round of electrician charges for the damages to my breaker box. The “Manager”Alan Torres kept trying to div

“Update “ Nov 24 and I haven’t received my refund , that company don’t respond to my emails or phone calls .

Edward was attentive and transparent.  He immediately diagnosed the problem as soon as he opened the bathroom drain cabinet (AC condensate line drains to bathroom sink and built up sludge). He made a couple of recommendations to maintain and avoid further costly repairs. If and when I need additional plumbing needs, I will request that Edward be dispatched to diagnose the issue.  Excellent service!!

Can't say enough great things about Reliant! We needed a kitchen faucet and garbage disposal replaced and they got us worked in almost  immediately. Our technician Zen was here on time for the estimate and was able to return the very next day to complete the work and perform a full house inspection. Everything is better than new! Five stars.

I had need of a plumber and had a great experience with Reliant Plumbing. James came out, on time, reviewed and gave me some pricing options.  Then Patton came out about an hour later and got the work done, while keeping me informed along the way with what he was finding and what he was doing!  Both were very professional, very polite, and based on this experience,  I would certainly call them again with any plumbing issues.

This is a company you shouldn't trust. They go for your throat with their estimates and lie to your face. They left a mess at this property. They cut and dug holes in places that was unnecessary trying to find a slab leak. It was like a treasure hunt. They didn't use a slab detection device which they didn't have.We were charged for this service and they failed to deliver the right way. It took about a
month for these guys to complete their work. They are not consistent with their work. We had t

Geo, Dustin, and Chris cleaned out a very nasty clogged drain and did a great job of explaining the repair to me.  Before that, another crew from Reliant came out and installed a tankless water heater in my home.  Everyone from Reliant was very professional and did a great job of communicating with me.

I had an excellent experience with Reliant Plumbing! Mark Smith was honest, professional, and incredibly prompt from start to finish. I reached out due to a suspected leak after noticing a high water bill, and Mark quickly diagnosed the issue. He determined that the leak was coming from the lawn sprinkler system and not the house plumbing, saving me from unnecessary repairs. His transparency and expertise were truly appreciated, as he took the time to explain everything clearly. Most impressivel

James from Reliant Plumbing was fantastic to work with! He thoroughly explained the entire process, always answered the phone when we had questions, and even helped facilitate back-office payments. Dealing with collapsed pipes as a first-time homeowner was incredibly stressful, but James and his team made it manageable. Everyone at Reliant Plumbing was professional and a pleasure to work with—I highly recommend them for any plumbing needs!

So shady. Needed to get a very small tankless water heater fixed in a rush and they were able to come out quickly which I appreciated.  I was told the estimate would be free but once the guy got there he surprised me with a $474 “diagnostic fee” and assured me even a new heater wouldn’t be expensive since it’s so small. He then goes on to inform me that he could not fix the 2018 heater and it needed to be replaced for $5500.

James came to my home because we had a water leak that was coming from our slab. He was very thorough and performed all testing to confirm that we had a slab leak. He came next day and rerouted our hot water line. He also educated us on the importance of water filtration and tested our  water. We opted to have him install a whole home water softener and carbon filter. WE NOW HAVE SOFT AND DRINKING QUALITY WATER FROM EVERY TAP!! Thank you so much James and Reliant Plumbing.

Patton is the best!  He was methodical and precise in the installation of my new tankless water heater. He is personable and listened to me as well as answered any question I had. Very informative and patient. He is a keeper!!

Mark and James some of the most well mannered individuals I’ve met. They fix my plumbing didn’t think it was gonna go so smooth. They were well trained and very professional, knowledgeable and even taught me to work on some things if something arise. Great  duel

Buyer beware for anyone planning to submit their receipt to insurance- they do not provide itemized receipts, so you will be unable to get reimbursed. They do not communicate this to you before you sign their paperwork. This experience left me with a very bad taste in my mouth about their business practices. I spent over $4,000 on their services, and they can’t provide me with a single itemized receipt? Shady.

In their response to this review, they give the illusion they want to discuss this fu

I was charged $562.00 so they could run their sewer machine and inspect for a clog. There was no clog. Basically, paid the amount for an inspection which is a service other plumbing companies do for free. They recommended I call a septic tank specialist to address the issue.

I rarely leave reviews, I wish 0 stars was an option but this situation has been beyond frustrating. Over six weeks ago, the company approved a refund due to a completely inadequate camera inspection. Their technician sent just pictures and claimed it justified a 10,000 dollar job with no video recording.

After recognizing the issue, they agreed to issue a refund, but I still haven’t received anything. Since then I’ve made multiple attempts to follow up. I’ve been told to “give it more time” an

James came to look at my old water heater that was leaking from the tank. He quickly diagnosed the issue and installed a brand new water heater and brought up to code for safety. He also tested my water and found that we have very hard water. So we also opted to install a whole home water filtration system. We installed a water softener and a carbon filter. The water is literally drinkable from every tap and so soft at the same. Thank you so much james! Highly recommend reliant plumbing for all
James with Reliant Plumbing came today to provide a quote. He has been very professional and helpful, providing a full picture of what's going on with my pipes. Thank you

I recently had a serious sewage line leak and James with Reliant was the best and I couldn’t be more satisfied with their service. From the moment I called, they were professional, responsive, and understanding of the urgency of the situation.

The plumber James arrived on time, quickly diagnosed the problem, and clearly explained the repair process. He worked efficiently and respectfully, ensuring the area was cleaned up afterwards. What really impressed me was how thorough he was-checking for

I recently had a slab leak at my property, and Mark and James handled the repair with exceptional professionalism from start to finish. From the initial inspection to the final cleanup, they demonstrated clear expertise and attention to detail.

They arrived on time, explained the issue thoroughly, and walked me through the repair process. Their communication was clear, and they made sure I understood what was being done at every stage. The work was completed efficiently, and they took great car
I was involved in an accident with one of their drivers and they have not been helpful at all. Their driver ran the red light and have dash cam footage that they won’t share!
Mark came out did a great job got me a new tankless same day very professional highly recommend

We found an issue with our dryer and we needed some help connecting the gas correctly. James came right away after we called in and was very knowledgeable and helpful. He was efficient and did fantastic work! I would highly recommend Reliant Plumbing!

I asked for a free check on work that had been done years ago and they came within just a few days and the technician was so friendly and helpful and gave me the “free recommendation” Per my request. All the work they’ve done at my home has been excellent. Highly recommend!

I had 2 other parties misdiagnose a leak so I called reliant in a panic and they came out on a Sunday for me and found the leak very quickly. They even referred me to a water restoration company to get things dried and fixed through insurance quickly. VERY grateful for a quick solve after more than a week of misdiagnoses. The leak has been stopped and I can finally fix the damage it caused.

Reliant replaced our pipes in Feb 2025, and by April 28th at 3am feces, raw sewage was overflowing from our shower drain with two small children in the house. Despite paying for their “preferred member” plan and 24/7 emergency service, we were left waiting all night with toxic fumes in our home and never received a single call or text back. Another company arrived in 15 minutes, documented multiple code violations in Reliant’s work, and confirmed the installation was done incorrectly from the st
Cullen Mayhew did a great job servicing my water heater. He was very professional and answered all of my questions. I will definitely call them again.
The gentlemen they sent was named James. He was very professional and knew what his doing and gave  us great service. Thanks again

The technician that went out to my house did a wonderful job clean up after himself couldn’t ask for a better technician…BUT!! when it came down to the payment horrible service. I’ve been trying to get a refund since  8/8 Friday and now it’s 8/15 for $255.88 and all I get it’s the runaround they say that “The refund manager it’s in a meeting as soon as they get done with that meeting they’ll call me between 5 and 6 PM”…..  A week and counting… they have some LONG MEETINGS

Reliant came out and gave me a quote to relocate my washer and they were by far the most expensive. At first they quoted 5.5k - I spoke with the plumber directly inquiring why such a high price tag given the limited scope of work. He didn’t provide clear answers, but ended up coming back with a quote that was 4.5k. Another company came out and did the work for 3k. Don’t trust these guys. UPDATE: here is a copy of your quote to prove it wasn’t “the other company” :)

Luke did a great job for us. He was able to get here earlier than expected. Got started right away, everything was clean when he left. He went over the repairs and explained the new system he installed.

James  with reliant plumbing came out and noticed my issues and came up with the cost that  I could afford. Helped with the issue and gave me the best case for what could pay for in stall a flow tech on the water heater and flush the system to at least get the storage cleared

Very professional highly recommend James and reliant plumbing

Had them come out to see about replacing a 6" sink drain pipe...
$1400.00. Legal robbery...of course I did not have the work done.So I had a contractor friend take a look. He completed the job in less than 30 minutes.Charge?.....$100.00.
Be sure to get multiple bids and don't pay these exorbitant prices.

Awesome team!! Patton was very knowledgeable, answered my questions and was great on his work. Both Patton and Quieontrey were very professional and courteous. Would hire again and highly recommend!! Very clean and patient. Thank you!!
Mark and james were amazing team. Came out to fix my water heater and did great work. Would recommend them to all my friends and family

James tightened my bolts and sealed the seal and toilet bowl to the ground. He showed up immediately after I called. I found Reliant online and they're the only company that will work on mobile homes.

James came out and helped us out at midnight and pulled two giant hair clips out of the toilet that my 3 yo son had flushed. Really helped us out considering we only have one toilet in the house. Highly recommend.

They took great care to ensure everything was installed perfectly and even cleaned up after they were done. It’s not often you come across such skilled and courteous plumbers. I highly recommend their services and will definitely call them again for any future plumbing needs. Thank you, Miguel and G
The appointment was scheduled promptly, and the technician Allan was knowledgeable, helpful, and took the time to explain all our options clearly. Highly recommend!
I had a great experience! Alan came to check out my water heater and was very communicative, friendly and knowledgable.
Allen was great in identifying potential issues with my water heaters. He gave me multiple estimates that were extremely detailed.

DON, did an excellent job fixing the plumbing in my bathroom. He was very professional, efficient, and took the time to explain everything to me. He arrived on time, worked quickly, and made sure everything was in perfect working order before they left. I really appreciate the  great service and attention to detail. Highly recommend!”

I needed my main water shut-off valve replaced, so I called Reliant Plumbing, and they sent Miguel. He was awesome! Miguel quickly assessed the problem, explained the process, and got to work right away. He replaced the shut-off valve without any issues, and now it works perfectly. I was impressed by how efficient and
knowledgeable he was - he even gave me tips on how to test it regularly to avoid future issues. If you need any plumbing work done, I highly recommend Miguel at Reliant Plumbing. S
